syncSegmentsEn.text: We do not know how far the road ahead is
Nor how many hardships and dangers there will be
But our desire is Already set and unchanging
Once the bow is drawn there is no turning back, no turning back
Come, let us work together as one
We will press through rushing waters and dangerous rapids
Do not fear the hard, winding road
We will pay the price in blood
Spreading the seeds of the gospel everywhere
We seek no earthly reward, only to be remembered in heaven
